beats.goal: The learner reads attribute values as quoted strings.
beats.content: An attribute value sits between two matching double quotes. If the closing quote is missing, the browser keeps reading until it finds another quote, and everything in between becomes part of the value.
beats.question: Where does the value of href end in

bug.explanation: The href value was missing its closing double quote, so the browser read on past the angle bracket and the link text became part of the address.
bug.hint: Read the link out loud and count the double quotes inside the a tag. Do they pair up?
